The firm supplies custom wire and cable assemblies to clients that require SDVOSB-certified sources, including government and prime contractor programs.

name: Pioneer Metal Sales, LLC
old_description: Working as a builder/roofer since the age of 18, Jason Coblentz (owner) worked with metal supplies on a regular basis.
about:
Pioneer Metal Sales, LLC operates from Karlsruhe, North Dakota, where it was founded in 2015 by Jason and Rachel Coblentz. Jason Coblentz had worked as a builder and roofer since age 18, gaining firsthand experience with metal supplies. Recognizing the need for custom, quality products with a fast turnaround, the couple purchased an empty lot on Main Street in spring 2015 and produced their first panels and trims that fall.

The company manufactures metal roofing and siding panels, trims, and related accessories using roll-forming equipment. In 2020 they added a second shop on the south side of Karlsruhe for cold storage, and in 2024 expanded that facility with a larger, more efficient manufacturing space. The new plant occupied in February 2025, houses additional trim roll-formers to boost production capacity and reduce lead times. The product line also includes fasteners, windows, doors, and underlayment.

Pioneer Metal Sales serves contractors and homeowners across the region, supplying roofing and siding materials for residential and commercial projects. Its customer base includes roofing contractors, siding installers, and general builders who require quick delivery of steel panels and trim components.

The business was started to provide premium-quality steel with a 1‑to‑2‑day turnaround and personalized, reliable service. The founders’ mission emphasizes affordability and responsiveness, aiming to meet the specific buying needs of each customer.

name: Pipeline Packaging - St. Louis
old_description: Including both glass and plastic options, Pipeline has bottles and jars for any application. Common options include pharmaceutical glass, food grade packaging and industrial containers.
about:
Pipeline Packaging operates from St. Louis, Missouri, where it was founded in 1988. The company is employee-owned, meaning every team member holds a stake in the business.

The firm distributes a broad line of rigid packaging — glass and plastic bottles and jars, metal and aluminum cans, caps, pumps, sprayers, steel and plastic drums, pails, tubs, and IBC totes — and backs those products with value-added services including custom assembly and decorating, engineering and testing, global sourcing, inventory management, packaging concept development, and warehousing and logistics. Its nine warehouses provide more than 1,000,000 square feet of storage, supported by a network of over 300 domestic and international suppliers.

Customers span pharmaceutical, food and beverage, industrial chemicals, automotive and coatings, agricultural and lawn care, household cleaners, and health and beauty markets. The company also handles hazardous-material packaging and spill-remediation support.

Pipeline positions itself as a flexible alternative to buying direct from manufacturers, offering just-in-time delivery, modified stock packaging, labeling, kitting, and customization without the high-volume minimums typical of factory-direct purchases. The employee-ownership model is cited as a driver of personal accountability and customer service.

name: Plaice Cove Electronics LLC
old_description: WE ARE A PREMIER HYBRID DISTRIBUTOR FOR ELECTRONIC COMPONENTS AND HARDWARE
about:
Plaice Cove Electronics LLC operates from North Hampton, New Hampshire, where it functions as a hybrid distributor of electronic components and hardware. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a complete solutions provider for the electronics manufacturing industry.

Rather than manufacturing products, Plaice Cove Electronics provides procurement and supply-chain services. Its offerings include global sourcing through vetted suppliers, an inventory management system (IMS), asset consolidation and management, and short- and long-term cost reduction strategies. The firm has developed custom web-based e-procurement software that gives customers real-time visibility into assets under management and financial analytics. A quality management process applies rigorous control standards to incoming materials, and the company also performs dimensional inspection of components.

The company serves customers in the electronics manufacturing sector, particularly those needing hard-to-find or obsolete parts. Its sales and purchasing teams act as a bridge between clients and their daily and long-term inventory requirements.

Plaice Cove Electronics emphasizes its global procurement network and strategic relationships as a source of competitive pricing. It also highlights its proprietary e-procurement platform and quality management standards that meet or exceed industry benchmarks as key differentiators.

name: Plane Woodworking
old_description: In today's disposable world, choose furniture that endures. Ditch mass-produced, disposable pieces for the timeless beauty of custom solid wood. Sure, the initial cost may be higher, but consider it an investment in quality and longevity.
about:
Plane Woodworking operates from Cinnaminson, New Jersey, where founder Bill transformed a personal woodworking hobby into a business aimed at supporting his family and connecting with the local community. The venture began with a desire to create lasting, handcrafted pieces rather than mass-produced alternatives, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces custom solid-wood furniture including desks, bed frames, shelving, cabinets, millwork, and trim, along with personalized cutting boards. It also offers a DIY wood cutting and drilling service for homeowners and professionals, handling materials such as sustainably sourced hardwoods, plywood, MDF, laminate, and butcher block. Precision cutting and drilling are performed with advanced equipment, though specific machine models are not listed.

Customers range from residential clients in the Cinnaminson area to businesses seeking engraved gifts for clients or employees. The company serves DIY enthusiasts needing cut-to-size components for countertops, shelving systems, or IKEA modifications, as well as professional woodworkers requiring accurate fabrication.

Bill emphasizes community and environmental stewardship: three percent of every sale funds tree planting through One Tree Planted, and materials are sourced from other small businesses whenever possible. The focus on solid wood allows pieces to be sanded, refinished, and handed down, contrasting with disposable furniture. Free consultations and fast turnaround times are offered to reduce waste and deliver professional results.

name: Plas-Tech Inc.
old_description: , we have been Nebraska's only low-density polyethylene bag manufacturer since 1991. Throughout the years we have remained committed to providing our customers with a quality of product and service they can't get anywhere else.
about:
Plas-Tech Inc. has operated from Omaha, Nebraska since 1991, when founder Gary Jasek established the state's only low-density polyethylene bag manufacturing facility. Jasek, who serves as owner and operator, brought more than three decades of hands-on experience in poly extrusion and converting to the venture.

The company produces low-density polyethylene bags, sheets, and tubing (roll stock) through extrusion and converting processes. Its product line includes shopping bags, food-service bags, trash liners, and flat bags, all made from virgin polyethylene that meets FDA and USDA requirements. The Omaha facility stocks a range of standard items and can fulfill orders of any quantity.

Plas-Tech serves commercial, retail, and food-service customers across the region. Typical applications include packaging for grocery stores, restaurants, and industrial users who require food-grade or general-purpose poly bags.

Jasek founded the business to provide a level of product quality and service that he felt was unavailable elsewhere in Nebraska, emphasizing competitive pricing and direct access to the owner-operator's technical expertise.

name: Plas-Tech Tooling Inc
old_description: Since 1993, we have been partnering with our customers to provide them with turnkey manufacturing solutions through production machining and plastic injection molding services. Our goal has always been to make their lives easier, saving them both time and money!
about:
Plas-Tech Tooling Inc. was founded in 1993 by Dean and Marcia Sonquist in Garner, Iowa. The business began in the couple’s garage, initially focused on injection mold building and repair for local manufacturers. By 1996 the operation had outgrown that space and moved to its current location in Garner, where it has expanded into a full-service machining and molding facility.

Today the company operates both a CNC machine shop and an injection molding department under one roof. Its machining lineup includes multiple Hurco vertical mills (VM10, VM30, VMX42, VMX50), Haas and Hurco lathes with live tooling and bar feeders, and a Puma 2600SYB II with opposing spindle. For molding, it runs a 300-ton JSW 280 ADS electric press and a 180-ton Sumitomo SH160 hydraulic press. Value‑added services include assembly, kitting, welding, inventory management, CAD drafting (SolidWorks, Mastercam), reverse engineering with a portable Hexagon CMM, and design‑for‑manufacturability feedback.

The shop serves a range of industries, with a noted focus on electronic‑industry fixturing using specialty plastics. It also supports startups and established OEMs that need rapid prototypes, emergency machining (including after‑hours response), or high‑volume “lights‑out” molding. Past work includes machining a critical part from solid bar stock when a casting supplier failed, delivering parts within weeks, and running high‑volume molding campaigns on electric presses.

Plas-Tech emphasizes the flexibility of a small company combined with the reliability and technology of a larger one. Its differentiators include in‑house tool design and build, no‑minimum‑quantity rapid machining, emergency machining with 24‑hour contact, and an ISO 9001:2015‑certified quality system that targets 100 % on‑time delivery and 100 % right‑first‑time components.

Plasti-Fab of Texas has operated from Rhome, Texas since 1988, providing custom plastic fabrication services to a range of industrial and commercial clients. The company was established as a fabrication shop focused on machining, forming, and assembling plastic components.

The shop runs 5-axis and dual-head CNC machines for precision cutting, alongside in-house vacuum forming, heat bending, plastic bonding, and plastic welding capabilities. It also offers planning and design support, engineering consultation, and on-site installation of fabricated assemblies. The facility houses what the company describes as some of the most advanced equipment in the United States, though specific square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span restaurants, aerospace, defense, general manufacturing, liquor and beverage, trade shows, retail stores, and scientific sectors. Projects range from small repairs to large plastic tanks, with the company handling both domestic and international shipping.

name: Plastic Design International Inc
old_description: PDI specializes in plastic injection molding and mold making, insert injection molding, and high volume injection molding.
about:
Plastic Design International (PDI Molding) operates from Middletown, Connecticut, where it was founded in 1977 as a short-run prototype R&D business. The company has since evolved into a full-service injection molding resource center with two facilities totaling 55,000 square feet.

PDI runs 21 injection molding machines ranging from 35 to 385 tons of clamping force, producing custom plastic parts, overmolded assemblies, and precision molds in-house. Its capabilities span plastic injection molding, insert molding, mold making and tooling, and value-added services such as design assistance, mold flow analysis, and coordinate measuring machine (CMM) inspection. The shop supports advanced quality frameworks including APQP and PPAP, and uses robotic sprue pickers, automated conveyors, and a central MRP system for scheduling and inventory control.

The company serves automotive, communications, defense, fire protection, and telecommunications sectors. Past projects include a glass-filled nylon filter housing for an automotive application, a 14-inch thermoplastic antenna housing for communications, an over-molded handheld antenna for defense, a pump housing molded in carbon- and glass-reinforced polyamide for hydraulic filtration, and an inner chamber for a fire protection system.

PDI emphasizes its ability to act as a single source from concept through molding and assembly, citing nearly five decades of experience, critical-tolerance expertise, and a documented quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ITAR, and RoHS standards.
